'''Kuppuswamy Nagarajan''' (15 September 1930 – 8 April 2023) was an Indian organic chemist.<ref name="INSA profile">{{cite web | url=http://www.insaindia.org.in/detail.php?id=N77-0499 | title=INSA profile | publisher=INSA | date=2016 | access-date=13 May 2016 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160812232359/http://www.insaindia.org.in/detail.php?id=N77-0499 | archive-date=2016-08-12 | url-status=usurped }}</ref>

Nagarajan earned a Ph.D. with Prof. [[T. R. Govindachari]], [[Presidency College, Madras]].<ref name="In memoriam – T. R. Govindachari (1915–2001)">{{cite journal | url=http://www.iisc.ernet.in/currsci/jan252002/219.pdf | title=In memoriam – T. R. Govindachari (1915–2001) | author=K. Nagarajan | journal=Current Science | date=January 2002 | volume=82 | issue=2 | access-date=2016-11-05 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041104203543/http://www.iisc.ernet.in/currsci/jan252002/219.pdf | archive-date=2004-11-04 | url-status=live }}</ref>

Nagarajan won the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]] for Chemical Sciences, 1974;<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/career/award/BPRIZE/Prize_Winner_Index%20(Chrono).htm |title=Prize Winner Index |access-date=2011-06-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110927141257/http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/career/award/BPRIZE/Prize_Winner_Index%20(Chrono).htm |archive-date=2011-09-27 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Nagarajan died on 8 April 2023, at the age of 92.<ref>{{cite web |title=Kuppuswamy Nagarajan (1930–2023) |url=https://www.currentscience.ac.in/Volumes/125/03/0332.pdf |website=Current Science |access-date=25 December 2023}}</ref>

Synthesis and Reactions of b-Fused 1(2H)-Isoquinolinones with unusual enaminic properties"], ''Helvetica Chimica Acta'', Volume 71, Issue 1, pages 77–92, 3 February 1988

Rodriguesa and Munirathinam Nethajib, [http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0040403900608808 "Vilsmeier-Haack reaction of 1-methyl-34-dihydroisoquino lines-unexpected formation of 2,3-bisdimethylamino-5,6-dihydropyrrolo (2,1- ) isoquinolines"], ''Tetrahedron Letters'', Volume 33, Issue 47, 17 November 1992, Pages 7229-7232
*Kuppuswamy Nagarajan, Joy David, Agasaladinni N. Goud, [http://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/jm00252a018 10-Alkyl- and 10-aminoalkyl-2,2'-bis(trifluoromethyl)-3,10'-biphenothiazines], ''J. Med. Chem''., 1974, 17 (6), pp 652–653, June 1974
